lede: KGC Workshop is a car workshop in Corporation Drive, Jurong East. Its own website lists car servicing, car polishing, spray painting and panel beating.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention help arranging a tow after a night breakdown, an Audi drive system fault fixed with an actuator change, and accident repair quotes.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, kgcworkshop.com.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
